name: capacitor-piano-midi
description: Capacitor 6 plugin: hardware MIDI input (USB + BLE) for iOS and Android. Polyfills navigator.requestMIDIAccess inside WKWebView.
author: Piano Visualizer team

scripts.verify: npm run verify:ios && npm run verify:android && npm run verify:web
scripts.verify:ios: cd ios && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace Plugin.xcworkspace -scheme Plugin -destination generic/platform=iOS
scripts.verify:android: cd android && ./gradlew clean build test && cd ..
scripts.lint: npm run eslint && npm run prettier -- --check && npm run swiftlint -- --quiet
scripts.fmt: npm run eslint -- --fix && npm run prettier -- --write && npm run swiftlint -- --fix --format
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && rollup -c rollup.config.mjs
